d:
PM Modi Visit Bihar : pradhanmantri narendr modi kal bihar daure par aa rahe hain. apne is daure ke dauran piem modi vaishali men navnirmit 'nitish setu' ka lokarpan karenge. iske bad rajapakar men aayojit vishal janasbha ko sanbodhit karenge.
Piem modi ke bihar daure ko lekar taiyariyan tej hain. vaishali men hone vale is karyakram par sabki najren tiki hain. nitish setu ke lokarpan se uttar aur dakshin bihar ke bich kanektiviti ko naee majbuti milne ki ummid hai.
